tabular_data.usage: SKUs, order IDs, channel IDs, numeric metrics

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders: Expose the skeleton. Use border-collapse style layouts with 1px subtle borders (border-r border-b border-border/40) for data-heavy sections.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Use flat designs with crisp 1px borders. Add slight shadow-sm on hover for interactive table rows or cards.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Avoid in data tables. Can use backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 for sticky headers or floating bulk-action bars.
visual_enhancers.corners: Sharp edges or max 4px (rounded-sm) border-radius. No pill-shaped cards.
visual_enhancers.textures: Clean, sterile, objective. Solid backgrounds to prevent visual refraction of data.

tables.styling: Dense spacing (p-2 or p-3 cells). Left-align text, right-align numbers. Sticky headers for long lists. Use standard React state for sorting/filtering.
tables.row_actions: Show quick actions (View Listings, Edit Master) on hover to reduce visual clutter.

cards.styling: Flat background, 1px subtle border, no shadow. Hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-lg.

buttons.styling: Sharp corners. Primary CTA uses primary color (#002FA7). Secondary actions use outline variants. Explicit hover states (e.g. hover:bg-blue-900).

badges.styling: Square or rounded-sm. Use distinct colors for Sync Status (Green=Synced, Red=Error, Yellow=Pending). Channel badges should use brand colors (e.g. Amazon Orange, Shopify Green).

wizard.styling: For CSV Import: 4-step horizontal progress bar (Upload -> Map & Validate -> Preview -> Commit). Use clear typography for step instructions.

forms.styling: Always explicitly define labels. Use structured grid layouts for catalogue attribute schemas.

toasts.styling: Use for sync success/failure notifications. Crisp edges, high contrast text.

dashboard_overview.span_logic: KPI cards span 1 col. Charts/Graphs span 2 or 3 cols.

master_detail.layout: Left pane (30% width) for lists/categories, Right pane (70% width) for complex details (like Catalogue Category Taxonomies or Listing Overrides).

grids_and_layouts.spacing_scale: Dense and compact for tables. Use p-4 for cards, p-2/p-3 for table cells. Provide ample p-8 padding for main page containers.

motion.hover_states: Quick transitions (transition: background-color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease). DO NOT use 'transition: all'.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-in (framer-motion) for dashboard KPI cards and table rows. Very subtle, 0.3s duration.

image_urls.description: Minimalist sneaker for master product list.

general_ui_ux_guidelines: Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Ensure high contrast for text over backgrounds. Use APCA contrast calculator rules.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='sync-button'`).
Do not use generic centered layouts for data apps. Left-align text, right-align numbers.
Always provide empty, loading, and error states for table views.
Maintain filtering, sorting, and pagination state in URL or local state.
Use progressive disclosure for channel-specific overrides (drill-down into details rather than huge tables).
Do not use complete transparent background in header, overlays, or dropdowns.
instructions_to_main_agent: Install dependencies: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react react-icons framer-motion sonner recharts
Add Shadcn UI components in .js/.jsx extensions (not .tsx) as the project uses JS.
Implement a persistent Sidebar navigation with Overview, Operations, Setup & Assets sections.
For the Master Products list, use a dense Table with IBM Plex Mono for SKUs.
For the CSV Import Wizard, create a stateful multi-step component (Upload -> Map -> Preview -> Commit).
For Channel Sync, MOCK the sync process with a timeout and show 'Synced' or 'Error' badges using Sonner toasts.
Implement the 'Swiss & High-Contrast' archetype: stark white background, sharp edges, 1px subtle borders, deep obsidian text.
